contract.ownership_enforcement: A plugin cannot unregister a listener owned by another plugin
contract.wrong_owner_result: Unregister with an incorrect plugin owner returns false
contract.registry_stability: A failed wrong-owner unregister does not modify the listener registry
contract.listener_preservation: The original listener remains registered after a wrong-owner unregister attempt
contract.delivery_preservation: The preserved listener continues receiving events
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after a wrong-owner unregister attempt
contract.permission_enforcement: Both unregistering and emitting plugins require the events permission
